scenarios.name: normal_state
scenarios.description: Page loads with intact plant assets, proper stacking (plant zIndex > jar-walls zIndex), and shelf container boundaries.

scenarios.name: font_fallback
scenarios.description: Font Awesome CDN is blocked/offline; page falls back to system sans-serif font family and preserves readable header and nav text.

scenarios.name: failed_asset_state
scenarios.description: Plant asset request (plant1.png) fails; page renders readable fallback badge (.plant-fallback) and updated alt text without throwing uncaught errors.

scenarios.name: failed_asset_recovery
scenarios.description: Restoring valid plant1 image source clears the fallback class and restores natural dimensions.

scenarios.name: empty_container_state
scenarios.description: When a shelf container has no plants, it displays .container-empty-notice ('No plants on shelf').

scenarios.name: empty_container_recovery
scenarios.description: When a plant element is placed on the shelf, the empty state notice is cleanly hidden.

scenarios.name: companion_fixture
scenarios.description: Dedicated companion page (3-terrarium/2-intro-to-css/companion.html) exercises empty shelf and broken asset recovery.
